verdict.rationale: Whether a vendor uses customer data for AI training is a fair privacy question for a cloud password manager, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack addresses an AI-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any related data-use control. The Environments MCP Server not returning secrets to agents is a different capability and does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
